crossRefs.note: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.
They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the…
Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.
How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart, for I am called by…
My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.
Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure…
But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets, but a doer of the work…

translations.web: so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul. If you have found it, then there will be a reward: Your hope will not be cut off.
translations.bsb: Know therefore that wisdom is sweet to your soul. If you find it, there is a future for you, and your hope will never be cut off.
translations.kjv: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul: when thou hast found it, then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.
translations.asv: So shalt thou know wisdom to be unto thy soul; If thou hast found it, then shall there be a reward, And thy hope shall not be cut off.
